messages.subject: stat_qq question
parts:
I would like to use qqplot to compare my data with a weibull
distribution, but when I use the following code, I get "Error:
length(quantiles) == n is not TRUE".

qq <- ggplot(service, aes(sample=time))
qq + stat_qq(dist=qweibull, shape=1.5720157, scale=4.3258983)

Did I do anything wrong? Thanks.

--

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: stat_qq question
parts:
Hmmm, this was a weird one. It'll be fixed in the next version of
ggplot2, but from now on you'll need to do:

qq + stat_qq(dist=qweibull, dparams = list(shape=1.5720157, scale=4.3258983))

Hadley
